_note: This file is a MMDetection configuration file containing only data structures (dicts, lists, variables). It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines a Cascade Mask R-CNN model with ConvNeXt-Large backbone for COCO instance segmentation training.
run_cascade_mask_rcnn_training: run the MMDetection training pipeline using this Cascade Mask R-CNN ConvNeXt-Large config for COCO instance segmentation
review_model_config: review the ConvNeXt-Large backbone config with depths [3,3,27,3] and dims [192,384,768,1536] for the cascade mask R-CNN model
summarize_train_pipeline: summarize the AutoAugment training pipeline with multi-scale resize from 480-800 and random crop augmentation policies
review_optimizer_config: review the AdamW optimizer config with layer-wise LR decay rate 0.7 across 12 layers and weight decay 0.05
review_bbox_head_config: review the three-stage ConvFCBBoxHead cascade config with decreasing target_stds and GIoU loss for 80 COCO classes
